name: Validating whether the new high-priority case has been created.
description: Validating whether a new high-priority case for Marc Henry has been created and assigned to Tabitha Bullock and Proactive Case Monitoring group.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case cc
JOIN product p ON cc.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN user u ON cc.assigned_to = u.user_id
JOIN user_group ug ON cc.assignment_group_id = ug.group_id
JOIN contact c ON cc.contact_id = c.contact_id
JOIN user cu ON c.portal_user_id = cu.user_id
WHERE p.name = 'SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 Variant 5'
  AND cc.priority = 'high'
  AND cc.state = 'new'
  AND cc.channel = 'email'
  AND u.first_name = 'Tabitha'
  AND u.last_name = 'Bullock'
  AND ug.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring'
  AND cu.first_name = 'Marc'
  AND cu.last_name = 'Henry';

name: Validating assignment policy.
description: Validating whether Tabitha Bullock is a member of Proactive Case Monitoring.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user_group_member ugm
JOIN user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Tabitha'
  AND u.last_name = 'Bullock'
  AND g.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring';

name: Validating report notification.
description: Validating successful report notification without knowledge article has been sent.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM notification n
JOIN customer_case c ON n.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.number = 'CS-0001233'
  AND n.type = 'report'
  AND n.status = 'success'
  AND n.email = 'marc.henry@stark-industries.com'
  AND n.knowledge_id IS NULL;
